pages.text: $(thing)Wireworms$() ($(o)Elateridae (click beetle larvae)$()), insect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() all crops.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-25 °C (best 18 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 4 years (larvae in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 30% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Avoid planting into freshly broken grass sod; Cultivate in late summer; Bait stations.$(br2)Worst in the first years after ploughing up old pasture.
